info.title: adclub.kz API
info.description: Generated from @adclub/contracts — do not edit by hand. Changes must be additive (ARCHITECTURE 7.4).

tags.name: auth
tags.description: Sign-in with a one-time code, sessions and devices

tags.name: catalog
tags.description: The catalog for every client, guests included (no session needed)

tags.name: vehicles
tags.description: The vehicle catalog for choosing a car, for every client, guests included (no session needed)

tags.name: public
tags.description: Open without signing in: cities and the connection request form (limited per client address)

tags.name: orders
tags.description: The user's own orders (context `user`, the mobile app)

get.summary: The signed-in member's profile (SCREENS M-PRO-02 «Мои данные»)

patch.summary: Change the name, e-mail, its newsletter consent, city or interface language; the phone number can't be sent here

get.summary: Every active order of the user in one answer, to keep on the device and read without a network (PRODUCT 6.7, «Сохранённая копия»): the code and the QR, the item and the sum, the supplier and — once accepted — the address, the hours and the phone (D-026), the main date and the time of the server for «Обновлено в {время}». No cursors and no filters: the answer replaces the copy whole; a user with more active orders than the setting gets the nearest deadlines

post.summary: Finish registration: give a name and the consent to share the phone number with a supplier (SCREENS M-AUTH-03)

requestBody.description: The member's name and the mandatory consent

post.summary: Send a one-time login code to a Kazakhstan mobile number (WhatsApp, SMS as fallback)
Check a login code; a correct code confirms the phone number and is spent
End the current session

get.summary: The signed-in account and the current session

post.summary: Exchange a refresh token (body for the mobile app, HttpOnly cookie for web clients) for a new token pair

requestBody.description: The refresh token (mobile), or an empty object (web, cookie)

get.summary: Active sessions (devices) of the signed-in account

delete.summary: End one of the account's own sessions; someone else's session answers like a missing one (404)

post.summary: End every session of the account, the current one included
End every session of the account except the current one

get.summary: The active category tree (goods, then services) in the language of the request; open to guests, cacheable for a minute
What the forms and filters of an active category are made of: its active attributes with types, units, bounds and options; hidden, archived and missing categories answer 404 alike
The items of a subcategory that have offers users see (M-CAT-02, M-CAT-03): city, car, filters, three orders, pages; open to guests, a user's session optional

post.summary: The compatibility of items (by ids, or a whole subcategory page by page) with a car, complete or partly known: the result, missing levels, whether a list shows the item and whether it needs a warning; open to guests

get.summary: The card of an item with the offers users see (M-CAT-07): photos, characteristics, compatibility, offers with receipt dates, analogs; the supplier's name and point only with club access; open to guests

M-CAT-09 from an offer of the catalog: the rating and «Новый поставщик», «Проверенный партнёр», the share of orders answered and kept in time — to every viewer; the name and the id of the supplier only by the rule of the showcase (club access). An offer users don't see now — 404

Search the catalog (M-CAT-04): an article in any spelling, names and synonyms in kk/ru/en, the wrong keyboard layout, transliteration; only what the catalog shows for this city and car; open to guests
Active cities in their order, in the language of the request, with the default one; open to guests, cacheable for a minute

post.summary: Complain about an order (M-ORD-06): an accepted order or one that is over; «Не получил товар» — an order given out; one open complaint per order. The supplier never sees complaints

get.summary: Every car of the signed-in account (SCREENS M-GAR-01)

post.summary: Add a car to the account's garage (SCREENS M-GAR-03); the first one becomes primary

requestBody.description: The levels, the modification, the colour and the key of this adding

201.description: The car was added — or, for an `idempotencyKey` seen before, the car it added

delete.summary: Remove a car; someone else's car answers like a missing one (404)

patch.summary: Replace a car's levels and colour (SCREENS M-GAR-06 «Дополнить»); someone else's car answers like a missing one (404)

requestBody.description: The levels, the modification and the colour

post.summary: Make a car the primary one (M-GAR-01 «Сделать основным»)
Merge the device's guest garage into the account's own, without duplicates (SCREENS "Перенос гостевого гаража"); idempotent

requestBody.description: Every car of the device's guest garage

200.description: The account's garage after the merge

post.summary: Read a car off a photo of a Kazakhstan registration certificate (SCREENS M-GAR-04): the photo is stored nowhere, nothing is added to the garage

requestBody.description: The photo itself (JPEG, PNG or WebP)

200.description: What the photo is and, for a certificate, its fields and their place in the vehicle catalog

get.summary: How many recognitions are left: a guest's trial ones on this device (T-GAR-04), or the account's for the day
Liveness: answers while the API process is up
The subscription of the signed-in account on any device (M-SUB-02): the status decided by the server, club access, the tariff and its announced change
Minimum supported client version per platform and the update message
The club's documents and contact (M-PRO-06) and the partner request page (S-PUB-01); open to guests

200.description: What is set; null — not set

post.summary: The app got (or opened) this push: confirms it; any device of the person confirms it. Someone else's and a missing one answer the same 404; a repeat is no error

delete.summary: Take this session's device off push (the server does it by itself when the session ends); nothing registered is no error

200.description: Nothing is registered for this session

put.summary: Register or refresh this device's push token (after the permission, at start with it, at sign-in, when the platform changes it). Bound to this session: its end takes the device off every push; a token another account had moves to this one

requestBody.description: The platform's token of this device

get.summary: Finished orders of the user in months of the club's time zone (M-ORD-02 «История»), newest first, in pages: the status, the date, the item, the sum, the supplier and whether «Повторить» and «Оценить» belong under it

The days and hours a visit for a service may be asked for now at the point of an offer (TASK-038; M-ORD-01 for a service): working days from today to the horizon, today cut to what is still ahead, in the point's time zone. An offer users don't see, or not on a service — 409 ORDER_OFFER_UNAVAILABLE / ORDER_KIND_NOT_SUPPORTED
The user's own orders (M-ORD-02): active or history, newest first; no codes

post.summary: Order from one offer on the showcase (M-ORD-01): a quantity, pickup or delivery, a comment; club access required; the answer has the confirmation code and the QR — for this user only. The same `idempotencyKey` again returns the order already created. TASK-038: an offer on a service makes an order on a service — a car of the garage (`carId`) and the time asked for (`desiredAt`), the price for the car's model

get.summary: One order of the user (M-ORD-03): the status and deadlines, the code and the QR while active, the terms, the course of the order; once accepted — the address, hours and phone of the supplier. Another user's order answers like a missing one (404)

post.summary: Cancel an order not given out yet, accepted ones too; cancelling an order already cancelled is no error
The screen of the order (M-ORD-03) is open: confirms every push of this order not confirmed yet — the app does not list the ones it never got

get.summary: What «Повторить заказ» can do with a finished order (M-ORD-02, M-ORD-03): the same offer of the same supplier with its price as it is today, the card of the item in the catalog, or a plain reason — the offer was withdrawn, the supplier isn't taking orders, the item left the catalog, there is no club access. The order itself is placed by `POST /orders`
M-CAT-09 from the user's own order: the same page as from an offer, for the supplier of this order. Another user's order answers like a missing one (404)

post.summary: Agree to the other term the supplier proposed for an order under order (M-ORD-03 «Согласиться»): the order is taken on with that term — «Срок подтверждён» — and the supplier sees the customer's phone. TASK-038: the same for another time of a service — the visit is confirmed at that time. Only the user of the order; after the answer deadline the order has expired — 409 ORDER_STATE_CONFLICT with `term_expired`

Say no to the other term (or, TASK-038, the other time of a service) the supplier proposed (M-ORD-03 «Отказаться»): the order is cancelled by the user and the supplier is told so. Only the user of the order

get.summary: Readiness: state of PostgreSQL, Redis and S3

503.description: At least one dependency is down

post.summary: Review an order (M-ORD-05): a score of 1–5 and a text if any; only the author of an order given out (a visit done), not a test one, one review per order. A text is checked before it is published; a score alone is published at once. The same `idempotencyKey` again returns the review created
«Опубликовать только оценку» after T-REV-02 (M-ORD-03): the refused text is dropped and the score is published
«Исправить текст» after T-REV-02 (M-ORD-03): once; the new text is checked again. Another user's review answers like a missing one (404)

get.summary: The published reviews of a supplier (M-CAT-09), newest first: the score, the text, the month, the author «Айгерим К.». By the rule of the showcase: to a guest and without club access the supplier is hidden and no review is given
Active modifications of an active generation (body, engine, transmission, drive, years, market) with the reference list names in the language of the request, Russian as the fallback
Active makes by name for choosing a car step by step; open to guests, cacheable for a minute
Active models of an active make by name; an archived, missing or malformed make answers 404 alike
Active generations of an active model with their years, newest first; 404 when the model or its make is archived or missing

sessionAccessToken.description: Access token of an active session (`SessionTokens.accessToken`). Expired: `ACCESS_TOKEN_EXPIRED` — refresh and repeat; `AUTH_REQUIRED` or `SESSION_ENDED` — sign in again.

ClientHeader.name: X-Client
ClientHeader.description: Client platform and version: `mobile/<version> (ios|android)`, `supplier-web/<version>` or `admin-web/<version>`. Missing or malformed values are accepted and treated as an unknown client.

AcceptLanguage.name: Accept-Language
AcceptLanguage.description: Preferred language for server-provided texts: kk, ru or en (default ru).

Error.description: Any failure, in the unified error format. `RATE_LIMITED` (429) also sets `Retry-After`; `details` is `RateLimitedDetails`

ClientUpdateRequired.description: The client's version is below the supported minimum: code `CLIENT_UPDATE_REQUIRED`, `details` is `ClientUpdateRequiredDetails`
